text:
ops-bot: @here Short update: expanding Blackwell B500 Dedicated preview across three regions after initial smoke tests. Details below.
eli_pm: This is still a preview. No SLA and do not promise GA. Signup form: https://redwood.example.com/b500-preview. Include workloads + expected QPS.
sanjay_infra: New capacity: eu-west-mad now 16 GPUs (4 nodes), ap-northeast-seo 16 GPUs (4 nodes), sa-east-1 pilot 4 GPUs (1 node). Pool names: b500-mad-preview-hsm, b500-seo-preview, b500-sao-pilot. Madrid HSM enabled; Seoul HSM scheduled overnight.
marina_prod: Perf snapshot for 8k context (GPT-like): Madrid p50 118ms/token, p95 330ms/token. Seoul p50 135ms/token, p95 375ms/token. Sao Paulo noisy due to egress; running more baseline jobs.
carlos_sre: Incidents: one Madrid GPU reported ECC spikes; power-cycle resolved. One Seoul node rebooted due to firmware hang; vendor patch queued. We added stricter early-alert thresholds: temp>=82C, mem errs>3/min.
ben_security: Reminder: Sao Paulo pilot is NOT compliant. Do not run regulated or PII datasets. Keys: HSM only in Madrid for now.
anya_sales: GTM: partners ProtoTech and EdgeSense moved to opt-in reserved billing for pilot. Messaging: call it an "early performance pilot" only. Route customer interest to me.
tom_gtm: Can infra grant per-team longer sessions?
sanjay_infra: Yes  per-team session overrides supported. Example CLI:
redwood infra override-session --team=prototypes --pool=b500-mad-preview-hsm --duration=24h --reason="partner eval"
eli_pm: Next steps: finish Seoul HSM, stabilize firmware, publish perf spreadsheet and CI links in #eng-runtime by tomorrow EOD. If you find issues open an issue in the "b500-preview" epic and ping infra.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Epic created: b500-expansion-week1. Thanks team!
